messages:
Ivy L: Heads-up: we want a minimal opt-in routing+quota shim for SDKs so console can finish attribution. Must be tiny, redactable, and non-blocking.

Marco P: propose headers:
X-RW-A: svc=pay;rh=0x4d
X-RW-Q: b=def;h=sha256:abcd1234
Emit only if client flag enabled.

Sabrina K: Console will accept both shapes for 30 days and store h as tenant_hash. No raw tenant in UI. We'll add header_version tag to samples.

Rajat S: Python/TS/Go SDKs add opt-in flag (enableRoutingShim). Default off. SDKs must redact any X-RW-* in error breadcrumbs.

Ivy L: streaming must not wait on any network call. Compute hash locally with optional salt; if missing, emit only X-RW-A.

Marco P: tests: unit for header emission, redaction tests and a staging ingest integration. Canary 1% then scale.

oncall-bot: created alert 'shim_cleartext_tenant' -> #devex-oncall.

sdk-bot: created RW-9001 and linked owners.

Sabrina K: migration playbook: short queries to reconcile counts, how to map hash back via console (audit-only), rollback steps. Keep <1 page.

Ivy L: ok I'll draft PR and playbook. Tag me when ready. Amanda oncall will watch canary. :thumbsup:
